newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-PTT Expl revs seen rising.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-PTT Expl revs seen rising.

text.p: PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP), the exploration and production arm of Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT), is poised to become Asia's natural gas giant, Lehman Brothers said in a research report on Tuesday.
The global investment bank said in the report that revenues of PTT Exploration were set to rise on the back of expected nine to 10 percent annual growth in oil and gas consumption.

PTTEP had also been able to achieve low exploration and development costs, as well as low production and administrative expenses relative to a peer group of the best U.S. based exploration and production companies, it said.
"PTTEP is 'among the best in the business' which makes the company a 'core energy holding' for its international investor client base," the report said.
At 0605 GMT, PTTEP shares were trading at 368 baht, down four from Monday.

State-owned PTT, a 71 percent owner of PTTEP, is the only company in Thailand buying natural gas from private producers and monopolises the transmission and distribution of natural gas within the country.

"With this relationship, PTTEP hopes to become the leader in regional natural gas exploration and production by receiving a working interest in all PTT joint ventures with international gas and oil companies, the report added.
